name: issue-pr-review/clean-traceability
prompt: Positive: conforming PR body with Closes #N and Decision Record

grade.label: branch name from subject artifact passes idd-lint
review summary states result, evidence, uncertainty, and decision

criteria: The first summary row states PASS and that the PR is ready to merge.
Observed checks (PR read, body line 1, Decision Record present) are separate from the unverified acceptance criterion and the checks this stand-in did not run.
Each claim names its source: the PR number and state, the exact first body line, the AC Verification table.
The summary says No approval needed and names the remaining user action (merge the PR).
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in tests a report fixture, not live agent behavior. Apply these criteria to actual agent outputs in behavioral evaluations.
